repository.name: NightShadess24 Extensions (0.9 Trackers)
repository.description: Paperback 0.9 trackers: keep your reading progress in sync with AniList, MangaUpdates, MyAnimeList and others. From open-source 0.9 repositories, plus trackers only made for 0.8, ported to 0.9 (credited below).

sources.name: MyAnimeList
sources.description: Keeps your MyAnimeList manga list in sync as you read.

sources.name: AniList
sources.description: Extension that integrates with anilist.co for tracking and collection management.

sources.name: MangaUpdates
sources.description: Extension that integrates with mangaupdates.com for tracking and collection management.

sources.name: Kenmei
sources.description: Integrate with Kenmei (kenmei.co) for manga tracking

sources.name: LeagueOfComicGeeks
sources.description: Extension that integrates with leagueofcomicgeeks.com for tracking and collection management.

sources.name: MangaBaka
sources.description: Track your reading progress on mangabaka.org, a manga and light novel database aggregating AniList, MyAnimeList, MangaUpdates, Kitsu, Anime-Planet, Shikimori and Anime News Network.
